title: Keep Like Counts Available
description: Two regions cannot communicate. The product allows a temporarily old like count but wants reachable replicas to answer. Which policy matches that requirement?

options.text: Reject every read until both regions agree.
options.explanation: That protects a single current view by giving up availability, which is not the stated preference for this operation.

options.text: Serve reachable copies and reconcile after communication recovers.
options.explanation: This favors availability during the partition while allowing stale values. Concurrent accepted updates need a reconciliation rule.

options.text: Require globally linearizable reads without blocking either region.
options.explanation: CAP rules out guaranteeing both properties during this partition.

options.text: Remove partition tolerance from the configuration.
options.explanation: A configuration cannot make the failed link disappear. The design must choose its behavior during the partition.
